title: Improving Repair Agents with Cause-Chain Diagnoses
abstract: arXiv:2611.30574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repair agents resolve a growing share of real-world issues. Starting with the same information as a developer reading a bug report, they have to find out how the program fails before actually fixing it.   We present FORECAST, which provides repair agents with a diagnosis of the failure. From the executions of passing and failing tests, FORECAST infers a cause chain, a short sequence of execution features, such as conditions or data flow, that explains how the failing runs diverge. FORECAST appends this cause chain to the issue an agent receives. It thus works with any agent that builds its prompts from the issue, without modifying the agent.   We evaluate FORECAST on all 300 issues of SWE-bench Lite with five repair agents and two models, the commercial Claude Haiku 4.5 and the open-weight Qwen3.5. With the cause-chain diagnosis, every agent resolves significantly more issues. Over all agents, the share of resolved issues rises from 48.5

translated_title: 基于因果链诊断改进修复智能体
translated_abstract: 修复智能体正在解决越来越多的现实世界问题。它们从与阅读缺陷报告的开发者相同的信息出发，需要在真正修复之前先弄清楚程序是如何失败的。我们提出了 FORECAST，它为修复智能体提供故障诊断。通过比较通过测试与失败测试的执行，FORECAST 推断出一条“因果链”——一段简短的执行特征序列（例如条件判断或数据流），用以解释失败运行是如何产生分歧的。FORECAST 将这条因果链附加到智能体接收的问题描述中，因此它可以与任何基于问题描述构建提示词的智能体协同工作，而无需修改智能体本身。我们在 SWE-bench Lite 的全部 300 个问题上，使用五个修复智能体和两个模型（商业模型 Claude Haiku 4.5 与开源权重模型 Qwen3.5）对 FORECAST 进行了评估。借助因果链诊断，每个智能体解决的问题数量都显著增加。在所有智能体上，已解决问题的比例从 48.5%（摘要在此处截断，应为提升至某个更高的百分比）。
tldr: FORECAST 通过比较通过测试与失败测试的执行推断出解释失败原因的“因果链”，并将其附加到问题描述中，从而无需修改智能体即可显著提升各类修复智能体在 SWE-bench Lite 上的问题解决率。
